title: Plugged in didn't work
text: Plugged in didn't work. What a total piece of you know what.  I opened it, plugged it in and yes read the stupid instruction book, nada nada,. You'd think these would be tested.  I'm so angry I can't think straight.  This isn't the first time I've received something that doesn't work right out of the box.
